name: Data Quality
description: Ensures data meets quality thresholds before analysis and modeling

criteria.name: Missing Data Threshold
criteria.description: Percentage of missing values does not exceed acceptable limit

criteria.name: Data Type Consistency
criteria.description: All features have correct data types without unexpected coercion

name: Model Validation
description: Validates model performance and generalization capability

criteria.name: Cross-Validation Score
criteria.description: Cross-validation score meets minimum performance threshold

criteria.name: Overfitting Assessment
criteria.description: Training-test performance gap within acceptable range
